issue_request: FHIR-10955 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification asking why ElementDefinition.short was described as a concise definition for XML presentation and accepting removal of that XML-specific wording.

additional_context: ElementDefinition remains in the current build scope as an active normative datatype in source/fhir.ini. Current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml contains the corrected wording, while the stale XML-presentation phrase is absent from current source outside historical release snapshots under tools/history. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the accepted clarification.
